name: 月神赐福
description: 获得1张随机圣光手牌，且你打出的下一张圣光手牌效果提高100%。
code: function executeSkill(context) { const caster = context.piece; const battle = context.battle; const player = battle.players.find(function(p) { return p.playerId === caster.ownerPlayerId; }); if (!player) { return { success: false, message: '找不到玩家' }; } const cardPool = ['holy-smite', 'holy-heal', 'holy-charge']; const randomCard = cardPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * cardPool.length)]; addCardToHand(randomCard, player.playerId); if (!player.buffs) player.buffs = {}; player.buffs['elune-blessing-buff'] = { multiplier: 2.0, uses: 1 }; return { message: caster.name + '获得月神赐福，得到1张圣光手牌，下一张圣光手牌效果提高100%', success: true }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: '获得1张随机圣光手牌，且你打出的下一张圣光手牌效果提高100%。', expectedValues: {} }; }
